name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.FlipShift.multiblock_cover_card_le
title: Label flips over fixed multi-block class maps need k times the total width to cover all strings
statement: Let each block r map X to Fin (W r). If a set F of (block, class) pairs covers X (every x lies in the class p.2 of block p.1 for some p in F) and every class in F holds at most k elements, then card X <= k * sum_r W r.
